findings.title: Medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
findings.evidence: Risk_Pipeline/01_IngestMarketData.py, Risk_Pipeline/02_VolatilityModel.py, and Risk_Pipeline/03_ComputeVaR.py show bronze -> silver -> gold flow.
findings.reasoning: The repository shows a bronze-to-silver ingestion step with validation, then a silver-to-gold reporting step, so it follows the medallion pattern rather than skipping layers or entering silver without checks. No repository-level architecture violation is present.

findings.title: Raw source data not modified in place
findings.evidence: Risk_Pipeline/01_IngestMarketData.py and Risk_Pipeline/03_ComputeVaR.py write to different output folders than the bronze inputs they read.
findings.reasoning: The repository reads from bronze paths and writes to silver or gold paths, but does not write back over any source path it reads. There is no in-place modification of raw data visible across the repository.
